what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Türkiye in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 19827 Turkish asylum seekers in the United States, 16.9% of all asylum seekers from Türkiye.
Refugees from Türkiye, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, France, Canada and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Turkey between the government and the PKK from 1995 to 2013 and from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Turkey from 2015 to 2017, and over the government of Turkey with TAK and Yurtta Sulh Konseyi in 2016.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 112 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 28521, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
